articles.title: Delap heads to Forest for £50m as Chelsea open talks to sell Jackson to Aston Villa
articles.summary: Forest to pay club-record £45m plus £5m in add-ons. West Ham’s Diouf likely to join Brentford soon. Nottingham Forest have agreed a deal worth £50m to sign Liam Delap from Chelsea, who have also opened talks over selling Nicolas Jackson to Aston Villa.
body: Xabi Alonso has made João Pedro and Danny Welbeck his main strikers this season, leaving his other frontmen to seek opportunities elsewhere.

Forest were one of several clubs interested in Delap, who has struggled since joining Chelsea from Ipswich for £30m last summer, and will pay a club record of £45m plus £5m in add-ons for the 23-year-old.

Delap managed only one league goal last season and was hindered by injuries after leaving Ipswich. But the former Manchester City striker was a key target for Forest’s manager, Oliver Glasner, and has a chance to revive his career at the City Ground.

Chelsea are focused on outgoings before the transfer window shuts next Tuesday and are also hoping to sell Jackson, who was on loan at Bayern Munich last season. The Senegal international is valued at £65m and has been earmarked by Villa as a potential replacement for Ollie Watkins, who is expected to join the Saudi Pro League side Al-Hilal.

articles.title: ‘Starting to wind me up’: Itauma rebuffs Hrgovic before world heavyweight title fight
articles.summary: Itauma can become second-youngest champion after Mike Tyson. Hrgovic claims title victory for opponent would ‘ruin his soul’ Moses Itauma has hit back at Filip Hrgovic’s taunt that he is a “delusional kid” and admitted that his Croatian rival is starting to annoy him as the two men prepare to fight…
body: “I tell myself there’s nothing that this Hrgovic guy can do to get in my head but he’s starting to wind me up,” Itauma said on Tuesday evening. “In an interview earlier, apparently he said I wake up and I just hug trees. He’s really starting to annoy me.

“In my mind if somebody’s trying to get one up on you, or trying to get in your head, it’s because they’re not confident in themselves. Obviously Hrgovic is a talker. Before fights, he’s always said certain things – like he did to [Daniel] Dubois when he said he sees big muscles but not big balls. Then you see Dubois, in his mind, is raging. So Hrgovic has always been a talker. It’s just because English ain’t his first language that people don’t pay attention.”

If Itauma beats Hrgovic, as expected, he will become the second-youngest world heavyweight champion in history. Only Mike Tyson won the title at a younger age and Hrgovic said of the 21-year-old Itauma: “He’s a kid. He’s inexperienced. So, for him, it would be best to lose this fight because it’s going to ruin him, winning the world title. He’s already in the clouds. He’s already delusional. And it can ruin someone who’s not ready for that kind of fame, that kind of money.

articles.title: ‘He’s box office’: Gary Lineker admits wanting Roy Keane to join The Rest Is Football
articles.summary: Podcast co-host says tongue-in-cheek that ex-Manchester United captain would like to sign up for his show. With an all-conquering podcast empire and a new deal that will make his football punditry show a regular fixture on Netflix, there seems little left for Gary Lineker to wish for.
body: However, while the former Match of the Day presenter is full of praise for Alan Shearer and Micah Richards – the fellow pundits on his The Rest Is Football show – Lineker has admitted to admiring a combative figure playing for his main rivals.

Asked which of the plethora of football pundits he would want to poach, Lineker admitted that Roy Keane’s brutal delivery and viral rants meant the former Manchester United captain would be his dream signing.
“He’s box office,” Lineker said during an appearance at the Edinburgh TV festival, before joking that, analytically, the Irishman “doesn’t give you that much”.

“He’s bloody good at being Roy Keane,” he said. “I’ve met Roy a few times. He’s really sweet … he just plays a character and he’s good at it. He’s really good at it, and he obviously knows his [stuff]. I was kidding about the analytical thing, a little bit.”

articles.title: Vuelta a España: Tadej Pogacar punishes peloton with mighty solo win on stage four
articles.summary: Slovenian powers to victory by more than three minutes. Leader breaks rivals on brutal climb at halfway point. Tadej Pogacar arrived in red, lit the fuse on the climbs and turned stage four of the Vuelta a España ⁠into a private exhibition on Tuesday, powering away with almost 50km remaining to win…
body: The Slovenian, bidding to ⁠complete his Grand ⁠Tour collection by ​claiming the Vuelta for the first time, attacked on the road to the second climb and quickly reduced a high-altitude battle into ⁠a one-man procession.

He began the final ascent with a lead of three minutes and 12 seconds and cruised over the last mountain pass before ⁠finishing in 2hr 40min 35sec. Jarno Widar won the sprint for second, 2min 39sec off the pace, with Felix ​Gall third.
Seven years after his only previous ‌appearance in the Spanish ‌race, Pogacar underlined why he started as the overwhelming favourite having recently claimed a fifth Tour de France title.
The UAE Team Emirates rider now leads the general classification by 3min 21sec over compatriot Primoz Roglic of Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, with Spain’s Enric Mas of Movistar 11 seconds further back.

articles.title: Fernandes and Shaw win PFA player of the year awards
articles.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes and Manchester City forward Khadija Shaw win the Professional Footballers' Associations men's and women's player of the year awards.
body: Both were previously named the Football Writers' Association men's and women's footballers of the year for the 2025-26 season.
Fernandes, who last season broke the record for the most assists in a single Premier League campaign with 21, is the first United player to win the award since Wayne Rooney in 2010.
It is a second win in three seasons for Shaw, who secured her third consecutive Women's Super League (WSL) golden boot with 21 goals as Man City were crowned champions.
City defender Nico O'Reilly succeeds Morgan Rogers as men's young player of the year, with the versatile 21-year-old cementing his place in the starting XI.

articles.title: PGA Tour play-off shake-up a 'big swing' - McIlroy
articles.summary: Back-to-back Masters champion Rory McIlroy believes the PGA Tour are giving fans what they want by changing their end-of-season play-offs to matchplay.
body: PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp confirmed on Thursday that from 2028 the Tour Championship will be played across two weeks, at two different courses, and adopt a head-to-head format.

World number two McIlroy, who is a three-time winner of the FedEx Cup, feels the return of matchplay to the PGA Tour for the first time since 2023 shows fans have been listened to by the decision-makers.

"I think the PGA Tour and the Future Competition Committee and Brian and everyone involved have really taken on board what the fans have been calling for and have wanted, which is matchplay," said the Northern Irishman, 37.
"Brian took me through the plan last week for the first time. I didn't really know anything about it. It's certainly different.

articles.title: Lancs' kids can benefit from struggles - Bohannon
articles.summary: Stand-in captain Josh Bohannon hopes that Lancashire's younger players can learn from the team's struggles in the County Championship this season.
body: Lancashire vice-captain Josh Bohannon says that the club's younger players can benefit from the tough experiences they are facing in the County Championship this season.
The Red Rose are sitting seventh in Division Two, having lost five of their past six matches, including their latest defeat, a 316-run hammering by Northamptonshire.
It leaves Lancashire facing possibly the lowest finish in the club's history, with only five games remaining.
Three players in the middle order for that game at Old Trafford had an average age of 19 and a combined 13 first-class matches between them.

articles.title: Sam LaPorta (hip injury) returns to practice, giving Lions huge boost
articles.summary: Sam LaPorta was back at practice Tuesday, Aug. 25, less than a week after Detroit Lions coach Dan Campbell said he wasn't sure if the tight end's hip injury would linger into the regular season.
body: LaPorta took part in the Lions ' two-hour padded practice Tuesday, going through position and team drills.
Campbell said last week that LaPorta's hip "flared up a little bit" after he got hit in the team's intrasquad scrimmage Aug. 17.
"It’s a little aggravated," Campbell said at the time. "But we feel good long-term about him. We’re just resting for a little bit here and letting it calm down.”

LaPorta missed the second half of last season with a back injury that required surgery but was a regular participant in practices before his hip injury. He set an NFL rookie tight end record with 86 catches for 889 yards in 2023 and has seen his production slip the past two years. In 2024, LaPorta had 60 catches for 726 yards, and last year he had 40 catches for 489 yards in nine games.

articles.title: Alvarez left with two options: Atletico or Arsenal
articles.summary: Julian Alvarez must take one of two paths before the transfer deadline: stay at Atletico Madrid and try to rebuild his connection with the fans or get his head around a potential move to Arsenal.
body: Atletico have told him again that they will not sell him to Barcelona and that - coupled with the reaction of the club's supporters on Sunday - has left him "devastated", according to well-placed sources in Spain.
The situation is now "extremely tense", according to Atletico expert and journalist Ruben Uría.

"Neither Miguel Gil Marín (CEO of Atlético Madrid) nor the Apollo board want to sell the player to Barcelona," he told Sky Sports News. "The entire Apollo board supports Gil Marín's decision. Alvarez has been told."

According to Uría, Arsenal sporting director Andrea Berta has remained in contact with his former Atletico employers in recent days after Alvarez was booed off by supporters in the opening LaLiga game against Villarreal.

articles.title: Gordon And Balde To Start | 4-2-3-1 Barcelona Predicted Lineup Vs Athletic Bilbao
articles.summary: Barcelona will entertain Athletic Bilbao at the Nou Camp this Thursday night as they look to earn a good result at home in La Liga. The Catalan club managed to secure a dominant 5-0 win over Elche last weekend, which should keep them in good spirits going into this game.
body: Hansi Flick will set his players up in a 4-2-3-1 formation and is expected to make some tweaks to his first XI for this contest. Anthony Gordon and Alejandro Balde could both play from the start of this game.

Joan Garcia will feature in between the sticks for the Catalan club after keeping a clean sheet in his last appearance. Eric Garcia will operate alongside Gerard Martin at the centre of Flick’s defence as they look to keep the opposition at bay during the 90 minutes.

Jules Kounde will fill in as the right-back, while Alejandro Balde hopes to prove his worth on the other side as the left-back. Both of them will get the license to go forward and express themselves inside the opponent’s half.
Pau Cubarsi will offer cover for the centre-back positions on the bench.

articles.title: Napoli still pursuing Arsenal’s Gabriel Jesus but need departures first
articles.summary: Napoli remain interested in Gabriel Jesus and are working to satisfy Massimiliano Allegri, who has asked the club to sign the Brazilian. According to Calciomercato.it, the forward is not considered a starter at Arsenal and could move to complete the attacking options at Allegri’s disposal before…
body: The obstacle is on the outgoing side. Napoli need to move players on before they can finance the deal for Gabriel Jesus, with Noa Lang and Lorenzo Lucca the two most likely to depart.

Bologna are interested in Lang as they look to replace seemingly Atalanta-bound Jonathan Rowe, while Lucca has drawn attention from a spread of Serie A clubs including Torino, Sassuolo, Fiorentina and Genoa.
Allegri’s interest in another centre-forward is notable given his public assessment of the striker he already has.
Speaking to Sky Sport Italia, the coach compared Rasmus Hojlund to Harry Kane but said the Dane still has significant room for improvement, particularly in his finishing.

articles.title: Littler's bid for historic PDC majors sweep suffers blow
articles.summary: Luke Littler's bid to qualify for the Players Championship Finals, and keep alive his hopes of claiming a historic clean sweep of PDC major titles in 2026, suffered a blow with a quarter-final exit at PC27.
body: Littler was beaten 6-5 by Jermaine Wattimena in a final-leg decider, with the Dutchman going on to take the title in Leicester, overcoming countryman Kevin Doets 8-6 in the final.
Littler beat Archie Self 6-2, Arno Merk 6-3 and then William O'Connor 6-3 to set up a last-16 tie with Chris Dobey, who he thrashed 6-0, before losing out to eventual champion Wattimena.
The world No 1 has won every major title on the PDC circuit so far in 2026 - the World Championship, Masters, UK Open, Premier League, World Cup of Darts and World Matchplay.

He still needs to win the World Series, World Grand Prix, European Championship, Grand Slam of Darts and Players Championship Finals this season in order to achieve something no-one has ever managed in the sport.
